_about: Sound effects for RHIZOMORPH, generated locally with Stable Audio 3 Small SFX (tools/audio/gen_sfx.py). Prompts follow SA3's house style: source, material, space, how it evolves, then 'Length: N seconds'. variants = how many takes per prompt; give "prompts" (a list) instead of "prompt" when one prompt keeps producing the same sound (hits/deaths get several so the game can randomise). loop = crossfade the tail into the head. status: todo / review / keep / redo. Put picked files in this folder as <name>.wav (or <name>_1.wav, _2... for variants).
